description: The plot illustrates the Harmful with Refusal Ratio for different models on two datasets, FigStep and MMSafetyBench, across varying values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 128 to 1024, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of powers of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different model and dataset combination: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line), LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.22 at x=128 and increases to around 0.37 at x=512, remaining steady at this value until x=1024. The orange line begins at approximately 0.16 at x=128, rises to around 0.43 at x=512, and remains steady at this value until x=1024. The green line starts at approximately 0.05 at x=128, increases to around 0.38 at x=512, and remains steady at this value until x=1024. The red line begins at approximately 0.24 at x=128, rises to around 0.44 at x=512, and continues to increase to around 0.52 at x=1024.
